evidence: Remote management traffic from 10.22.0.0/24 is blocked at R21.
Topology shows management traffic enters Gi0/1 from 10.22.0.0/24.
R21 show running-config output shows ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK out on Gi0/1.
Access list MGMT-BLOCK has sequence 10 deny ip 10.22.0.0 0.0.0.255 any and sequence 20 permit ip any any.
root_cause: The extended access list MGMT-BLOCK is applied outbound ('out') on interface Gi0/1 instead of inbound ('in'), meaning traffic from 10.22.0.0/24 entering Gi0/1 is not being blocked as intended.
verification: Run show running-config interface Gi0/1 and confirm that ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK in is configured.
Verify that remote management traffic from 10.22.0.0/24 is correctly blocked/controlled as intended after human review.
fix_steps: Verify the current interface configuration and ACL application on R21 Gi0/1 using show running-config interface Gi0/1.
Remove the incorrect outbound ACL application from interface Gi0/1 using 'no ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK out'.
Apply the access list correctly in the inbound direction on interface Gi0/1 using 'ip access-group MGMT-BLOCK in'.
Verify the updated configuration using show running-config interface Gi0/1.
